name: Nordic Papercut Lightbox Theatre
zh: 北欧童话多层剪纸光影剧场
summary: Andersen-style Nordic paper-cut tunnel book lit from behind: a 2700K tungsten vellum backlight (#FFF5D1 → #F5A34A), five stacked 300gsm Canson card layers (sky peaks, fjord village, forest bridge, foreground arch, proscenium) with multi-radius parallax cast shadows, subsurface amber glow and 45° scalpel-bevel highlights; Falu-red lighthouse with vellum windows, hanging eight-point Bethlehem paper stars and folk-cut reindeer. Natively supports 1920×1080 (16:9 wooden-frame stage) and 1080×1440 (3:4 five-layer tunnel book).
